content.title: Abeona Therapeutics Wins FDA Approval For First-of-Its-Kind Gene Therapy
content.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on Tuesday approved Abeona Therapeutics Inc.’s (NASDAQ:ABEO) Zevaskyn (prademagene zamikeracel) gene-modified cellular sheets, also known as pz-cel, as the first and only autologous cell-based gene therapy for wounds in adult and pediatric patients with recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB).
